On this course you structure evidence-led heritage research and citation.

The course is run for your batch on dates you choose. Timings, pace and assessment are agreed before it begins.

What it covers

  • Research design
  • Finding scholarship
  • Writing with citations
  • Peer review

Course outline

  1. Research design

    Evidence types, questions and scope.

    You: proposal outline

  2. Finding scholarship

    Library databases and reading notes.

    You: bibliography

  3. Writing with citations

    Claim-evidence paragraphs and references.

    You: write section

  4. Peer review

    Revision and citation integrity.

    You: final short essay

The number and length of sessions are agreed with your batch.

You take away

A portfolio of your work from each session.
